metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – SPEC‑008 (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: AA Escalation • Consent • Paradox • Harmonic Gate • RTT7–RTT12
metadata.description: Defines normative rules for AA escalation, paradox entry, harmonic routing, and RTT12 collapse.

claims.status_line: AA3 escalation requires explicit operator consent; auto-escalation is forbidden.
claims.projection: RTT12 lattice is a projection of frozen RTT v0.9; this SPEC does not revise RTT v0.9.

invariants.inv.aa3.consent: AA3 MAY NOT activate unless operator_consent = true.
invariants.inv.skip_resolution.forbidden: RTT12 collapse MUST occur; skipping resolution is forbidden.
invariants.inv.paradox.typed: RTT7 entry requires a typed paradox event.
invariants.inv.measure.required: Every gate MUST cite a measure ID defined in fft.ai.core.json.

branch.if_consent_true: AA3 escalation permitted; dispatch harmonic operator.
branch.if_consent_false: Hold at AA2, log paradox event, stop dispatch.

harmonic_escalation.notes: Harmonic escalation is agentic-only unless substrate bridge declares a parametric path.

rtt12_collapse.collapse_rule: RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.

session_rules.lineage: Session lineage MUST be non-decreasing across RTT1–RTT12.
session_rules.continuity: measure.c3 MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.
session_rules.rewind: RTT11 inversion maps directly to frozen RTT rewind.

non_claims: This SPEC does not redefine SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
This SPEC does not alter frozen RTT lineage or safety envelopes.
This SPEC does not introduce new substrate classes.
